resources.string: Searching Gnosis Chain for stamps this account bought…
Buying the stamp… The node swaps xDAI for the xBZZ it needs, buys the stamp, and waits for each transaction to confirm on Gnosis Chain. This takes a minute or two.
Extending the stamp… The node swaps xDAI for the xBZZ it needs, tops the stamp up, and waits for each transaction to confirm. This takes a minute or two.
Depositing… The node moves the xBZZ into its chequebook and waits for the transaction to confirm on Gnosis Chain. This takes up to a minute.
Connecting the stamp your wallet bought… The node checks it on Gnosis Chain and, the first time, sets up its chequebook. This takes up to a few minutes.
Stamp bought. It becomes usable once the network has seen it, usually within a minute.
Stamp connected: the node publishes with it.

Your wallet pays for everything at once: it swaps xDAI for xBZZ, buys a postage stamp that belongs to the node, and sends the node xDAI for its own transactions — through the SwarmNodeFunder contract, as Freedom on desktop and iOS do. Once it\'s mined, the node connects the stamp and, the first time, sets up its chequebook.
The quote was over a minute old, so it\'s been priced again. Check it and review again.

It isn\'t mined yet as far as Gnosis Chain shows. The app keeps checking its transaction and connects the stamp if it lands. Dismissing forgets the batch: a stamp that lands afterwards can\'t be connected.
It may or may not have been mined. If it was, Connect adds the stamp to the node. Dismissing forgets the batch: a stamp that lands afterwards can\'t be connected.

Turn on the Swarm node to see its chequebook.
The chequebook needs light mode, which connects the node to Gnosis Chain. Switch it on under Publishing on the node page.
The node has no chequebook yet. It sets one up with its first postage stamp.
The node\'s account holds no xBZZ. Send xBZZ on Gnosis Chain to the node\'s address first: a deposit moves xBZZ the node already holds, it doesn\'t swap xDAI.
The node\'s account holds only %1$s. Choose a smaller amount, or send xBZZ on Gnosis Chain to the node\'s address first.

The node moves %1$s from its account into its chequebook at %2$s, and pays up to %3$s of gas for the one transaction. The xBZZ then pays other nodes for pushing what you publish, and, while Pay peers from the chequebook is on, for faster downloads and uploads. This is a real transaction on Gnosis Chain and can\'t be undone.

The chequebook pays other nodes in xBZZ: for pushing what you publish into Swarm, and for faster downloads, like video and large files, than the free tier carries. Spending never goes past what is deposited; when the credit runs out, downloads carry on at the free tier.
What the node can still pay: the balance below, less the cheques it has written that peers haven\'t cashed yet.
The node couldn\'t count the cheques it has written, so this is the balance below: what is left is less.
The payment record was lost and you confirmed it, so the cheques the node wrote before that aren\'t counted here: what is really left is less.
What the chequebook contract holds. It only drops once peers cash their cheques, so it can read as more than is left to spend.
no chequebook yet. The first postage stamp sets one up.
the payment record was lost. See below.
the credit is used up. Downloads may be slow; deposit to pay peers again.

the node isn\'t paying from this chequebook yet. It usually starts within a minute, once it has read the chequebook\'s funds from the chain; if it doesn\'t, the node couldn\'t verify the chequebook on chain, and downloads stay on the free tier.
The credit is low. Deposit more to keep paying peers.
The credit above is only an upper bound, so it may run out sooner than it shows. Deposit more if downloads slow down.
Faster downloads and uploads, paid from the credit above. Off keeps both on the free tier, even with credit left.

Measured on Swarm mainnet: about 0.59 xBZZ per GB downloaded when every piece is paid for, and about 0.16 xBZZ per hour of HD video when the free tier carries most of it (an estimate). Uploads cost about 0.22 xBZZ per GB. Spending never goes past what is deposited.

The node lost its record of the cheques it wrote from this chequebook, so it stopped paying peers: downloads and uploads use the free tier until you confirm. Peers it paid before may hold cheques the node can no longer see.

This accepts every cheque the node wrote from %1$s before the record was lost, including ones it can no longer count. Peers holding those cheques may refuse new ones, and disconnect the node, until its new cheques pass what they hold. Afterwards the spendable credit leaves those lost cheques out, so it reads higher than what is really left. Nothing is sent on chain.
Confirmed. The node pays peers again within a minute.
Nothing to confirm: no lost payment record is on file for this chequebook.
